clockConvention.sourceFrame: one-based sprite frame at 12 visual fps
clockConvention.declaredSampleStart: sum of preceding SWF block sample fields in this sprite
clockConvention.declaredSampleEnd: sum through block on named frame
clockConvention.signedBlockSeekSamples: raw SWF field, not a measured playback correction

Right4 frame 31 retires feedback and resumes main; MP3 EOF alone does not complete the lesson.
